item.title: An update
item.content:encoded: Original author here. You all asked some good questions and I've updated the article. Unfortunately, SCP-919 can't resurrect the dead. You can, however, use it to effectively kill someone over and over again. I'm sure the Foundation has had reasons to do that sort of thing.

item.title: Re: What if exposed to another mirror?
item.content:encoded: The reflection would still disintegrate. It needs the original to be present for it to exist.

item.title: Re: What if exposed to another mirror?
item.content:encoded: If you walk away from a normal setup where a mirror is reflecting a mirror, your reflection doesn't stay, so I imagine the reflection would still disintegrate. I'm wondering, however, if this would create some sort of feedback loop where all of the reflection's reflections decouple as well.

item.title: What if exposed to another mirror?
item.content:encoded: What if the subject was placed between 919 and another mirror that was placed behind the subject? If the subject were to leave would 919's reflection reflect onto the other mirror stopping the loop, or would it still shatter?

item.title: Re: Interesting thought here
item.content:encoded:
I mean, bring in the bodies of our dead enemies, interrogate the reflection and then if a true any (probable) point where the reflection doesn't want to cooperate, we can just threaten to move the body away!

Small problem. In the SCP, the guy was shot dead while they were still exposed to the SCP. As the reflection was no longer acting like one, it didn't "die" until after the body was moved.

If the SCP is reflecting a dead body, why would we expect said reflection to suddenly get up after the 15 seconds of exposure and beg to not be killed? Though it is sometging worth investigating…

item.title: Interesting thought here
item.content:encoded:
If the reflection was able to remain "alive" and fully capable of speech…then had the addition of ALL it's "Reflectors" memories…couldn't this be a HUGE asset in information gathering?!!?! I mean, bring in the bodies of our dead enemies, interrogate the reflection and then if a true any (probable) point where the reflection doesn't want to cooperate, we can just threaten to move the body away! It seems like doing so is something that causes insane amounts of stress and anxiety for the reflection and we could actually keep doing it again and again because, due to the nature of the SCP and it's regained memory of the last time the body would have been taken away, the SURELY they would open up like a book concerning the information we Foundation members seek.

I'd like to pose the idea to the EC as soon as schedules permit.
